paragraphs: The “Business & Industrial” category is a top-level department in Shopify’s product taxonomy. It brings together the product families assigned to Business & Industrial, providing the starting point for classification throughout this branch of the catalog. Its immediate branches include Advertising & Marketing, Agriculture, Automation Control Components, Construction, Dentistry and additional specialized categories.

When describing products in Business & Industrial, useful Shopify classification details include Color: Defines the primary color or pattern, such as blue or striped; Material: Defines a product's primary material, such as cotton or wool; Pattern: Describes the design or motif of a product, such as floral or striped. These are descriptive comparison points rather than required GitStore category fields; retain the product’s actual characteristics when choosing a category. Where an immediate branch describes the product more precisely, follow that branch and continue to the most appropriate specific category.
